design.input_history: recorded learner prefix then expert observations; not autonomous model rollout

control.description: Frozen 300-epoch local-state distillation versus original BC, same parent joint-training-control/epoch-300 and expert rehearsal. Final checkpoint only. Train-only accepted targets.
control.selection: maximize verified development pick-place, then minimize masked validation MSE, then earlier epoch
control.test_policy: evaluate selected candidate only; no test-based tuning

distilled.description: Frozen 300-epoch local-state distillation versus original BC, same parent joint-training-control/epoch-300 and expert rehearsal. Final checkpoint only. Train-only accepted targets.
distilled.selection: maximize verified development pick-place, then minimize masked validation MSE, then earlier epoch
distilled.test_policy: evaluate selected candidate only; no test-based tuning

limitations: One seed, 101 static train-only local targets on expert-observation trajectories. Single control-period joint-state targets omit object/task objectives. No independent tests or deployment; lower offline error did not improve closed-loop grasping.
